The coefficient condition (i-s)a_i=0 for 0<=i<=p-s leaves s-1 free high coefficients, plus the i=s coefficient iff 2s<=p; for s=0 the derivative kernel consists only of constants. Thus dimension is 1 at s=0, s for 1<=s<=m, s-1 for m<s<=p-1, m=(p-1)/2; zero f has centralizer dimension p. Valuation s has exactly (q-1)q^(p-s-1) rational elements. Combining strata gives exact histogram, sum=q^p and sum_f q^dimC=q^(p-2)(q^3+m(q^2-1)), so cd=(q^3+m(q^2-1))/q^(p+2). An independently written modular row-reduction of ad(f) exhaustively verified all F5^5=3125 elements, histogram {1:3000,2:120,3:4,5:1} and 21625 commuting ordered pairs. Infinite-field-extension validity is symbolic from the coefficient equation, not from finite tests. Scope p>3 prime, q=p^e, same standard truncated-polynomial derivation algebra.
